service.description: Create a draft production run (design-manufacturing NewWorkOrder, §12.1's create#ProductionOrder contract): the product checked usable for Produce (check#ProductUsable), Mantle's ManufacturingServices.create#ProductionRun without the legacy consume and produce products (no PatMfgBom row is read or written, D15), WepProductionRun in WeInPlanning owned by the organization (R-SA-03), its own lines (ProductionRunLine: the output, a material line per component Products' released BOM requires as of the method date, now by default, stopping at non-phantom sub-assemblies and blowing phantoms through with their routing, and the by-products) and the WeptConsume/WeptProduce rows planning reads (R-SA-05). The run's revision is 1, its method date, BOM, routing and demand links audit-logged fields. A retry with the same operation key answers the first draft (existing true). Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN (PERMISSION_DENIED) and the method read the explosion checks; refuses an organization or facility outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a facility of another owner (FACILITY_OWNER), no product (PRODUCT_REQUIRED) or quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), a product that cannot be produced (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE), no released BOM at the date (METHOD_REQUIRED), several (METHOD_AMBIGUOUS) and an explosion with findings, a routing that is not released or that misses a line's operation (METHOD_INVALID).

parameter.name: quantityUomId
parameter.description: The BOM's unit when empty.

parameter.name: productBomId
parameter.description: The product's MAIN (or only) released BOM when empty.

parameter.name: routingWorkEffortId
parameter.description: The BOM's routing when empty.

parameter.name: methodDate
parameter.description: As of when the BOM and routing are read; now when empty.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode CREATED, workEffortId, organizationPartyId, facilityId, productId, productBomId, routingWorkEffortId, methodDate, revision, lines, operationCount, and the operation fields.

service.description: Release a draft run (design-manufacturing WorkOrderDetail, §12.1): the product checked usable again; a release of the run's BOM, a phantom's BOM or its routings since the run's method date and in effect now is refused (METHOD_CHANGED) unless reexplode, which rewrites the draft lines and the WeptConsume/WeptProduce rows as of now and answers the draft for review (resultCode REEXPLODED, still WeInPlanning, at the next revision), to be released with that revision (R-SA-12); with no later release the lines are kept. The routings and BOMs checked are those the run was read from (productionMethodRefs: a phantom's routing whether or not a line names its operation). Then the operation children (WetTask, WeApproved, the run's owner, each with its routing operation, sequence and work center, audit-logged) from the routings as of the method date, the lines frozen (frozenDate) on their operations, the WorkEffortProduct rows rewritten from the lines, the frozen standard (the approved ProductStandardCost in effect now for the organization and facility, Products P9) and the release time stamped, the revision counted up, and the run WeApproved. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not a draft (RUN_NOT_DRAFT), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a run with no lines (LINES_REQUIRED) and a product that cannot be produced (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode RELEASED (or REEXPLODED with findings), workEffortId, statusId, releaseDate, methodDate, reexploded, revision, productStandardCostId, operationWorkEffortIds, lines, and the operation fields.

service.description: A production run as MaterialIssueReceipt and WorkOrderDetail show it: the run (status, facility, owner, revision, method date, release time, BOM, routing, the frozen standard's id and, with ACCOUNTING_VIEW, its unit cost, the demand links), its lines (material: issued, returned, remaining; output: received, remaining), its operations, and its issuances and receipts (a movement's value only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW). Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or STOCK_ISSUE (the warehouse issues to it); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Issue a component to a released run's material line (design-manufacturing MaterialIssueReceipt Issue, M2): a new AssetIssuance per operation key and line, never added to an earlier one (D13), through mantle.product.AssetServices.issue#AssetToWorkEffort with the run's workEffortId (AssetIssuanceGlPost moves the cost to WIP, the run owning it), the line and operation and the quantity as entered on the issuance; the expiry gate (WarehousePolicy.expiryBlock) refuses an expired asset inside the issue (ASSET_EXPIRED). The quantity is in the stock unit, or in the line's unit through its exact conversion. Its cost event (record#ProductionCostEvent) references the hook's transaction (impl-manufacturing P6). A retry with the same operation key answers the first and writes no event. Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not released (RUN_NOT_RELEASED), a line of another run or role (LINE_INVALID), an operation of another run (OPERATION_INVALID), another unit (UNIT_CONVERSION), stock outside the user's facilities, not stock, or short (posting.stock's refusals), another product (PRODUCT_MISMATCH), stock that is not available, a quarantined one among them (HELD_STOCK), another owner's (OWNER_MISMATCH), more than is free (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE), more than the line has left beyond its scrap allowance (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: the over-consumption tolerance of the ProductionPolicy the run was released under, none without a policy; impl-manufacturing P4) and a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED, read without locking).

parameter.name: quantityUomId
parameter.description: The stock unit when empty.

parameter.name: operationWorkEffortId
parameter.description: The line's operation when empty.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode ISSUED, workEffortId, productionRunLineId, operationWorkEffortId, assetId, productId, lotId, quantity, assetIssuanceId, remaining (the line's, after), warnings, productionCostEventId, and the operation fields.

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, plan.run.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.product.issuance.AssetIssuance', issued.assetIssuanceId, {resultCode: 'ISSUED', workEffortId: plan.run.workEffortId, productionRunLineId: plan.line.productionRunLineId, operationWorkEffortId: plan.operationWorkEffortId, assetId: plan.asset.assetId, productId: plan.asset.productId, lotId: plan.asset.lotId || null, quantity: production.text(plan.unit.stockQuantity), assetIssuanceId: issued.assetIssuanceId, remaining: production.text(production.materialTotals(plan.line).remaining), warnings: warnings, productionCostEventId: costEventIds[0]})

service.description: Return unused material from a run (design-manufacturing MaterialIssueReceipt Return unused, M2): a new receipt fact through mantle.product.AssetServices.receive#Asset, into the original asset where it is or into a new asset at the chosen location with the original acquireCost, lot and owner, with the run's workEffortId, AssetReceipt.sourceAssetIssuanceId and the issuance's operation, so AssetReceiptGlPost posts Dr inventory, Cr WIP at the original cost in the open period (D13, R-SA-02). Never cancel#AssetIssuance or an update of the issuance. After a provisional output receipt the return lowers the WIP the rest of the output takes (warning PROVISIONAL_TRUE_UP naming the receipts the cost close trues up); once all the output was received at a provisional cost it is refused (PROVISIONAL_CLOSED). Its cost event references the hook's transaction, and material with no cost, which would post nothing (F13), is refused (COST_UNAVAILABLE; impl-manufacturing P6). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses an issuance that is not a work effort's or a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a closed or cancelled run (RUN_CLOSED), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), more than is left of the issuance (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ISSUED), a facility of another owner (OWNER_MISMATCH), a closed or missing location (LOCATION_CLOSED, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE, LOCATION_REQUIRED) and a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED, read without locking).

parameter.name: toFacilityId
parameter.description: With toLocationSeqId; the original asset's facility when empty.

parameter.name: toLocationSeqId
parameter.description: Empty returns into the original asset.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode RETURNED, workEffortId, assetIssuanceId, assetId (the stock returned to), intoOriginal, productId, quantity, facilityId, locationSeqId, assetReceiptId, productionCostEventId, and the operation fields.

service.description: Receive a released run's output (design-manufacturing MaterialIssueReceipt Receive output, M2): through mantle.product.AssetServices.receive#Asset with the run's workEffortId and owner, at the run's frozen standard unit cost (its productStandardCostId, R-PRD-29); with no approved standard at the run's net WIP times the quantity over what is left to receive (the last receipt takes the rest), costProvisional; never without a cost (D12, R-SA-01, COST_UNAVAILABLE). The unit cost is kept at four decimals rounded down and the last unit received apart at the remainder's cost, so the receipts carry the value exactly (P6, F166). Output that needs inspection (the tracking policy's inspectionRequired or a published production template, P8) is received AstQuarantine into quarantine with an inspection of each receipt (QisWorkEffort); otherwise to the location given or the putaway resolver's. Serials one per unit (given, or generated from firstSerialNumber by P7's generate#TrackingIdentities rules), a lot by number. Each receipt carries the output line, the operation and the quantity as entered, and has its cost event, which references the hook's transaction and refuses a receipt without a cost (COST_UNAVAILABLE; impl-manufacturing P6). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not released (RUN_NOT_RELEASED), a line of another run or role (LINE_INVALID, LINE_REQUIRED), a by-product, whose cost allocation is not built (BYPRODUCT_NOT_COSTED), more than the line has left (OVER_RECEIPT), a facility of another owner (OWNER_MISMATCH), the tracking checks (SERIAL_COUNT_MISMATCH, SERIAL_DUPLICATE, LOT_REQUIRED), the destination's refusals and a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED, read without locking).

parameter.name: productionRunLineId
parameter.description: The run's output line when empty.

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: The run's facility when empty.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode RECEIVED, workEffortId, productionRunLineId, operationWorkEffortId, productId, quantity, facilityId, locationSeqId, statusId, inspected, serialNumbers, costSource (standard or issued), costProvisional, assetIds, assetReceiptIds, qualityInspectionIds, productionCostEventIds, and the operation fields; unitCost only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW.

service.description: Receive a subcontract's finished work (design-manufacturing SubcontractDetail, M2; Warehouse runs it from SubcontractShipmentDetail), in one transaction: the run's material lines (of the dispatch's operation, else of the run) issued from the vendor-custody facility the dispatch went to (P15) at the output's share of each line (backflush) or the supplier-reported actuals after review (materialQuantities by line), each through issue#ProductionMaterial under this operation's key; the output received through receive#ProductionOutput with the run's workEffortId and no transfer shipment, never on the service purchase line (which would value it at the PO price); then Purchasing's service acceptance (mantle.order.purchase.ServiceAcceptance, the accept#ServiceItem contract) of the dispatch's service order item with the output receipt and its inspection as evidence, under this entry point's check (§2). A retry with the same operation key answers the first, so the line is accepted once. Requires STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a shipment that is not a subcontract dispatch (NOT_SUBCONTRACT), a facility that is not in custody (NOT_CUSTODY), an order not with its custodian (CUSTODIAN_MISMATCH), stock missing at the vendor facility (MATERIAL_SHORT), and the refusals of the issue, the output receipt and the acceptance (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ORDERED, ORDER_CANCELLED, NOT_SERVICE).

parameter.description: The run's output line when empty.

parameter.name: materialQuantities
parameter.description: Reviewed actuals in stock units by material line; the output's share of each line when empty.

parameter.name: toFacilityId
parameter.description: Where the output goes; the run's facility when empty.

parameter.name: acceptedQuantity
parameter.description: The service quantity accepted, in the order item's unit; empty takes the item's quantity in the output's proportion (all that is left with the last of the output), at most what is left to accept.

parameter.description: resultCode RECEIVED, shipmentId, workEffortId, operationWorkEffortId, vendorFacilityId, issues (line, asset, quantity, assetIssuanceId), output (the output receipt's result), serviceAcceptanceId, orderId, orderItemSeqId, acceptedQuantity, and the operation fields.

service.description: The production policy in effect (design-manufacturing ProductionSettings) for an organization, at one of its facilities (a plant's override) or for a run, as of a date: each value with its source (the built-in default, the organization's default or a facility's override, with the row's dates and reason; traceRows has the display text), the row set at the exact scope (configuredPolicy, expectedFromDate) and its history. A run is read at its owner and facility as of its release time (a draft as of now), the policy it keeps; asOfDate reads another time. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or PRODUCTION_POLICY_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization, facility or run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). The production guards read the policy through ProductionPolicy.js's runPolicy, which checks no permission.

parameter.name: organizationPartyId
parameter.description: The facility's or run's owner, else the user's active or first organization, when empty

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: Empty for the organization's default

parameter.name: workEffortId
parameter.description: A production run, read as of its release time

parameter.name: policy
parameter.description: The value of each field in effect

parameter.name: sources
parameter.description: Each field a row sets: level (organization or facility), facilityId, facilityName, fromDate, thruDate, changeReason

service.description: A dated production policy change for an organization (no facility) or one of its facilities (a plant's override): consumption (manual or backflush, the issue point, the over-consumption and overproduction tolerances in percent, substitute approval, the quality defaults, and the completion-on-final-receipt and strict-release flags), time and cost (time logging, machine runtime, the work type, piece rate, the labor cost flag, estimate refresh and close approval) and planning (horizon, time fence, shortage release, calendar, lead-time basis and freshness limit). An empty value inherits. The row in effect at the start ends there; the new row holds its values with the changes, every field audit-logged with the reason. A released run keeps the row of its release time. Requires PRODUCTION_POLICY_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization or facility outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale expectedFromDate (POLICY_CHANGED), a start before now, a second row at the same time and an invalid value (POLICY_INVALID).

parameter.name: fromDate
parameter.description: Empty starts now

parameter.name: expectedFromDate
parameter.description: The fromDate of the row in effect at this scope when the form was read, empty when none

parameter.name: policyGroup
parameter.description: consumption, timeAndCost or planning: only that group's fields change (one ProductionSettings form); empty changes every field given

service.description: The production reason codes of an organization as of a date (design-manufacturing ReasonCodes): each code with its row in effect and display text, by sequence and code; inactive codes (no row in effect, with their latest row) only with includeInactive; with reasonCode, that code's dated rows (history). Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or PRODUCTION_POLICY_EDIT; refuses an organization outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Add, change or deactivate production reason codes of an organization, each reason on its own: a new code (reasonName and reasonCategoryEnumId required), a change (a dated row from fromDate, now when empty, that ends the one in effect) or, with active N, a deactivation that ends the row in effect. A reason is never deleted, so the events that name it keep it; each row's fields are audit-logged with the reason. Every reason is checked before any is written, and one refused is named in results (REASON_INVALID, also for a deactivation before a change already scheduled, REASON_CHANGED for a stale expectedFromDate, REASON_INACTIVE) while the others are stored; the save is refused when none is. Requires PRODUCTION_POLICY_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: reasons
parameter.description: Maps of reasonCode, reasonName, reasonCategoryEnumId, equipmentFault, plannedStop, approvalThreshold, sequenceNum, active (N deactivates), fromDate and expectedFromDate

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: Each reason: reasonCode, resultCode (STORED, CHANGED, DEACTIVATED or REFUSED), errorCode and message when refused

service.description: Write the cost event of a source record of a production run (design-manufacturing ProductionCosts, §12 M8; crosscut CX-COST), inside the transaction of the fact that causes it: the production guards call it for each issuance (issue#ProductionMaterial, and receive#SubcontractOutput's material through it), return (return#UnusedMaterial) and output receipt (receive#ProductionOutput). The event is derived from the source alone: the run, line, operation, product, quantity, the asset's cost as its rate (an output's rate row the run's frozen standard), the amount signed for the run's WIP and the AcctgTrans the movement's hook posted (posting nothing again; PclNotPosted when the hook posted nothing, and unvalued without a cost). One event per source, component and revision: a second call answers the first (existing true). Internal: it checks no permission, the caller's guard did. Refuses a source that is not a production run's movement (SOURCE_INVALID) and a receipt without a cost, which would post nothing (COST_UNAVAILABLE, F13); an unknown source entity is an error.

parameter.name: sourceEntityName
parameter.description: mantle.product.issuance.AssetIssuance or mantle.product.receipt.AssetReceipt; later phases add theirs

parameter.name: sourceRevision
parameter.description: 1 when empty; a correction of the source (a timesheet reopened, a rate changed) is its next revision

service.description: A production run's cost evidence (design-manufacturing ProductionCosts Costs and CloseReview): the run, its cost events (type, component, product, quantity, source, valuation and ledger state; each amount, rate and ledger link only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW), the frozen estimate it was released with for its output quantity (with PRODUCT_COST_VIEW or ACCOUNTING_VIEW), the actual cost by component with the material issued and returned, the output's relief and the WIP balance (with ACCOUNTING_VIEW), the estimate against the actual (with both), the exceptions that stand in the way of the cost close (unvalued, not posted and awaiting-close events) and the cost review (its status, whether the user may request it now and why not, a closed-period warning). A value the user may not read is left out, never zero. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_COST_REVIEW or ACCOUNTING_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: estimate
parameter.description: Only with PRODUCT_COST_VIEW or ACCOUNTING_VIEW

parameter.name: actuals
parameter.description: Only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW

parameter.name: comparison
parameter.description: Only with both

service.description: Put a production run's costs up for Accounting's cost close (design-manufacturing ProductionCosts CloseReview; Accounting's ProductionCostClose posts it, P15): the run's cost-review status PcrRequested with the date, the user, the revision, the proposed accounting date (today when empty) and a note, audit-logged run fields, and the ProductionCostReview notice with the run and its revision to the organization's users holding PRODUCTION_COST_POST. A closed fiscal period of the accounting date is a warning (PERIOD_CLOSED). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_COST_REVIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a draft (RUN_NOT_RELEASED), a closed or cancelled run (RUN_CLOSED), a run with no cost events (NO_COST_EVENTS) and one whose review was already requested at this revision (REVIEW_REQUESTED).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode REVIEW_REQUESTED, workEffortId, reviewStatusId, revision, accountingDate, notificationMessageId, exceptions, warnings, and the operation fields.
